LanguageData.JiRikknitAddiction.label: ji rikknit addiction
LanguageData.JiRikknitAddiction.description:
A chemical addiction to ji rikknit. Long-term presence of ji rikknit has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug.
Without regular doses of ji rikknit, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
